# INDEX.TXT
Ten photographs from the first years of going up: the Earth, the Moon, the planets, and further. Open them in Pictures; copy one to C: to make it your wallpaper.

EARTHRIS.PIC  Earthrise. Apollo 8, 24 December 1968.
MARBLE.PIC  The Blue Marble. Apollo 17, 7 December 1972.
ALDRIN.PIC  Buzz Aldrin on the Moon. Apollo 11, 1969.
BOOT.PIC  A bootprint in the dust of the Moon. Apollo 11, 1969. Nothing there moves it; it will still be there.
SATURN.PIC  Saturn at equinox. Cassini, 2008.
JUPITER.PIC  Jupiter. Hubble, 2014.
PILLARS.PIC  The Pillars of Creation, in the Eagle Nebula. Hubble, 1995.
CRAB.PIC  The Crab Nebula, what is left of a star seen to explode in 1054. Hubble, 2005.
ISS.PIC  The International Space Station. From Atlantis, 2010.
COLUMBIA.PIC  Columbia, the first shuttle, leaving. STS-1, 12 April 1981.
